previous_applications.action: Filter: strictly keep previous_applications where decision_datetime < cutoff_datetime

bureau_observations_by_application.action: Filter: strictly require available_datetime <= decision_datetime. Reject records where available_datetime > decision_datetime even if report_datetime <= cutoff.

account_behavior.action: Filter: strictly keep complete months only, i.e., month.dt.offset_by('1mo') <= cutoff_datetime

repayment_history.action: Filter: strictly keep installments where due_date < cutoff_datetime. Furthermore, if last_payment_datetime >= cutoff_datetime, payment was made in the future: mask payment or treat as unpaid at cutoff!

ecommerce_transactions.action: Filter: strictly keep transaction_datetime < decision_datetime. For spending aggregates, filter out order_status == 'cancelled' and deduplicate by order_id before summing order_total.
